Factors and native units are SST (°C), 200–850-hPa shear (m s⁻¹), mid-level RH (percentage points), 200-hPa divergence (10⁻⁵ s⁻¹), ascent (; Pa s⁻¹) and hemisphere-signed 850-hPa vorticity (10⁻⁵ s⁻¹), sampled at 200–800 km.
